d: Discover the fascinating story of Kamal Haasan and Rajinikanth, two of the biggest superstars in Indian cinema who started their journeys together but went on to create two completely different cinematic legacies. From working together in 21 films during the 1970s and 1980s to deciding never to share the screen again, this is the untold story of their friendship, careers, and the decision that shaped Tamil cinema. How did two actors trained by the same legendary filmmaker, K. Balachander, become such different icons?
